mutations.id: T01 the in-flight guard is dropped from Approve
mutations.expect: second Approve while the first is still in flight

mutations.id: T02 the in-flight guard is dropped from Download
mutations.expect: second Download while the first is still in flight

mutations.id: T03 an export refusal is swallowed
mutations.expect: export refused by the server is reported by its code

mutations.id: T04 a failed detail read falls through to an empty batch list
mutations.from:
// Left null: the batch list renders its UNKNOWN state rather than claiming nothing was sent.
        this.detail = null;
mutations.expect: detail read that failed says the batches are unread
